excerpt.zh: 最近从[surveyed_planets_system.GetName]星系得到的勘查数据中没有风信子号的迹象。也许我们应该到别的星系碰碰运气。
excerpt.en: The survey data recently acquired of the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.

texts.zh: 最近从[surveyed_planets_system.GetName]星系得到的勘查数据中没有风信子号的迹象。也许我们应该到别的星系碰碰运气。
texts.en: The survey data recently acquired of the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.

texts.zh:
在最近对[surveyed_planets_system.GetName]星系的调查中找到了独特的离子轨迹。该轨迹与秋菊号引擎留下的轨迹十分类似，因此一定就是风信子号留下的！

尽管这条微弱的离子轨迹已经留存超过一个世纪了，但科学专员还是沿着这条轨迹找到了一颗之前从未发现过的恒星。我们已经将坐标录入了情报日志。
texts.en:
The survey data recently acquired bears marks of a unique, residual ion trail in the [surveyed_planets_system.GetName] system. It is identical to the one that was produced by the Chrysanthemum's engines. It must have originated from the Hyacinth!

Although the faint ion trail is over a century old, we have been able to track it on an outbound trajectory towards a previously uncharted star. We have entered its coordinates into the Situation Log.

label.zh: 风信子号一定就在那里。
